name: Emergency Ride Home
description: Reimbursement for eligible emergency rides home (up to $125/ride, 4 trips and $500/year)
fullDescription: The Transportation Authority of Marin (through Marin Commutes) reimburses emergency rides home for people who walk, bike, carpool, vanpool, or take transit to work or college in Marin County.
whatTheyOffer:
- Reimbursement for emergency rides home by taxi, Uber, Lyft, or similar service
- Up to $125 per ride (tips not included)
- Up to 4 trips and $500 per fiscal year (July 1-June 30)
- Covers illness or crisis, unexpected late work, carpool/vanpool falling through, or bike problems
howToGetIt:
1. Must be 18+ and work in Marin County or attend a college in Marin County
2. Use an alternative commute mode (transit, vanpool, carpool, bike, or walk) on the day of the emergency
3. When an eligible emergency occurs, take a taxi or rideshare home and keep your receipt
4. Submit the reimbursement request form with receipts within 30 days of the trip
5. Reimbursement is mailed as a check, usually within 30 days of approval
keywords: emergency ride, Marin Commutes, reimbursement, taxi, Uber, Lyft, commuter, carpool, transit, bike, walk
